metrics.reference_relative_primary: H02: candidate B/F/SIGNAL Irrelevant BA minus fixed qualified R2 SIGNAL Irrelevant BA at each candidate seed; descriptive and secondary to H01; no best-reference selection.
metrics.feature_comparison_scope: H03/H04 are secondary prespecified B/F/Irrelevant balanced-accuracy comparisons at each fixed seed. All pairs/settings/relevances/metrics remain mandatory H05. See exact normative reporting contract; no information-test interpretation.
metrics.contrast_sign: Literal left-minus-right for every metric; BA higher is better, LL/CBLL/Brier lower is better. No common combined score.

seed_policy.reference_reuse: Same authenticated deterministic recipe panel across candidate settings and seeds; repeated comparator appearances are not new observations.
seed_policy.individual_reporting: Always all three seed records including failed/unavailable status; fixed seed order. No best seed, retry, setting, arm, metric or relevance selection.
seed_policy.descriptive_summary: For an otherwise identical report cell, mean=(v97097+v97098+v97099)/3 and min/max require all three complete finite values, identical cohort/projection/splits/metrics/access/mode/budgets, and the same prospectively fixed campaign-level agent/model/prompt/code-authoring procedure. Realized authored learners, chosen family/search policy and fitted parameters may vary across seeds as intended agent variation and must be reported separately; they are not required to have byte-identical source. Within each setting/seed, the same sealed family/search/query policy remains required across all five feature arms. Apply the summary separately to scores and paired differences; never average predictions into an ensemble.
seed_policy.incomplete_summary: If any required seed value missing/unqualified/invalid, three-seed summary null with all original reasons; available individual values remain explicitly incomplete diagnostics, no mean over survivors.
seed_policy.interpretation: Three seeds quantify these realized algorithm/agent outputs descriptively. Not population biological replicates, independent trial/fold evidence, calibrated uncertainty or an expectation over an unobserved seed distribution.

conditions.I_after_query: May write/run bounded query-specific analysis and select among frozen training-derived model states. No new statistical fit/normalization/calibration after query exposure; no cross-query state. Actual query source and operations are captured by controller.

claim_boundary.permitted_statement: On this admitted fixed panel, the specified procedure using the left projection obtained a signed difference of delta in named metric relative to the specified right procedure/projection under this setting and seed.
claim_boundary.positive_BA: Supports only greater realized held-out balanced accuracy for these bounded procedures/cases. Does not establish conditional information, neural source, confound elimination, population generalization or a theory.
claim_boundary.zero_or_negative_BA: Does not establish absence of information or conditional independence. Function class, optimization, regularization, feature dimension, noise, finite sample, thresholding and seed effects can limit or reverse this comparison.
claim_boundary.loss_disagreement: BA/loss/control signs may disagree because they measure different properties; report all without choosing the favorable metric.
claim_boundary.independence: H03 and H04 share inputs/left predictions and cohort; they are not independent replications. N098 reuses the corpus and cannot be independent replication either.
claim_boundary.multiplicity: Hierarchy is a fixed reporting order, not a sequential statistical-testing or alpha-spending scheme. No p-value, population CI, significance/pass threshold or posthoc claim selection is defined.
